offering_description.value: Provides truckload freight transportation, mainly dry van, for shippers across the US and cross-border with Mexico and Canada. It operates its own tractors and trailers with company drivers and some owner-operators, and also offers expedited, temperature-controlled and regional services after acquisitions.

primary_services.value: truckload freight transportation; dedicated trucking; expedited freight; temperature-controlled freight; regional trucking

customer_segment.value: B2B: shippers such as retailers, manufacturers and consumer goods companies, plus freight brokers

end_markets.value: retail; consumer goods; manufacturing; food and beverage; general freight

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-mile and per-load freight charges plus fuel surcharges for truckload hauling

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates tractors, trailers and terminals, hauling freight for shippers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with cross-border service to Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: dry van, expedited, regional, dedicated and temperature-controlled truckload services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales team contracting directly with shippers; agents / brokers: freight brokers and third-party logistics providers tendering loads

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FMCSA and DOT safety, hours-of-service, emissions and driver rules for motor carriers
